hero.question_em2: already has the check in hand
hero.lead_html: Inside this platform there are hundreds of real buyers — with approved financing or cash in hand — waiting for someone to offer a property like yours. You don't advertise. You negotiate.

pain.lead: That is how the traditional market works — and that is why properties sit for 6, 12, 18 months with no clue why.
pain.c1_title: You pay to feature on a portal
pain.c1_body: And you have no idea whether the person who saw your ad has R$ 1 million, R$ 50, or nothing. You pay to show up for anyone — window-shoppers included.
pain.c2_body: They take 6% and the buyer "comes by luck". You are stuck with the visit queue — with zero feedback when the queue dries up.
pain.c3_body: You lower the price. Take new photos. Wait another 3 months. Still no idea what is wrong — you just feel something is.

inversion.eyebrow: The game flipped for you too
inversion.lead_html: Every buyer arrives at the platform answering a detailed brief: neighborhood · budget · deadline · payment type. You access this list. Filter by compatibility. And offer directly to whoever fits.
inversion.card_note: Illustrative example — real data appears after you register your property.
inversion.outro_html: This is no longer a classified portal. It is a demand marketplace — whoever is buying shows up for you, check in hand.

how.title: 4 steps. No mystery.
how.s1_b: Photos, price, conditions. In 10 minutes your property is on our radar.
how.s2_b: The platform shows active buyers with compatible profile. You see the full brief of each one.
how.s3_b: Send a personalized offer. No middleman, no queue — you talk straight to the buyer.
how.s4_b: Direct conversation, no 6% agency commission in the middle. If you want our team alongside, that is optional.

guarantee.lead_html: Did you offer to 5 matching buyers and none accepted? Our team analyzes your property and tells you exactly why it did not sell. No spin, no excuses.
guarantee.branch1_body: We show you exactly what to improve — angle, light, missing rooms, furniture that hurts the perception of space.
guarantee.branch2_title: Your price is off the market
guarantee.branch2_body: We compare with similar properties sold in the last 90 days — and tell you where your price needs to drop (or if it is actually fair and the problem is elsewhere).
guarantee.branch3_body: We show with real data that no one is looking for that type of property in your neighborhood — so you can decide to wait, rent, or pivot.
guarantee.outro_html: Here you do not sit in the dark for months hoping for a miracle. You know.

demand.title: The buyers are already here — how many?
demand.note: * Data updated in the last 48h. Active buyers with validated brief.
demand.outro: Every number above is a real buyer with a signed brief, verified budget, and defined deadline. It is not anonymous portal traffic.

support.eyebrow: Optional · If you want our team alongside
support.title: Self-service is the default. Full-service is on demand.
support.lead: Whoever sells through Achamos goes straight to the buyer — that is the point. But if you want us to take on any part (or all of it), it is possible, no monthly fee. Commission only on the sale.
support.i1_b: We tell you the real market value, no inflation — so you can price with conviction.
support.i2_b: Partner photographer, no extra cost. Professional photos make a difference in offer rates.
support.i3_b: Beyond our buyer radar, we distribute your property on portals and social media.
support.i4_b: Only qualified people show up at your door — with validated brief and verified budget.
support.i5_b: If you prefer, our team leads the conversation — offer, counter-offer, closing.
support.i6_b: All the bureaucracy through to the deed, so you do not have to worry.
